text: We cannot confirm whether this rural asset (ID: ASSET-J) has lost tree cover since 2020. The assessment returned *insufficient evidence* because the required satellite data coverage for this specific asset was missing during the analysis period (2021–2025). No observations were made due to gaps in available datasets (e.g., Hansen GFC, JRC GFC2020, MGAP 2021). This means we cannot rule out tree-cover loss, nor can we confirm it occurred. Further investigation with higher-resolution or additional imagery would be needed to determine the asset’s status.
